thread:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick sync: vendor asked for a single embargo handoff for H100/H200/MI300 across NA/EU/APAC. SI wants staggered onramp by region because of driver cert timing. Can we map a clean announce plan?
Faye (Marketing): Staggered is fine but press asked for unified messaging. We need exact embargo windows per region so PR team can prep localized quotes.
Carlos (Platform): From infra side: H100 images are green for NA/EU. APAC still has a firmware derate on some B200 blades causing perf variance. That derate needs vendor microcode (expected 5-7d).
Nora (Solutions): SI integration checklist: driver signing, storage snapshot for live migration tests, and versions for our onboarding playbook. If APAC waits, SI can run dry-run for NA/EU first.
Priya (Partnerships): Vendor note: they'd prefer a single public announce date but will provide region-specific availability dates. They want Redwood to hold embargo until their OEM press window closes (they promised 72h). Is that workable?
Jasper (Legal): We need explicit embargo agreement with timestamps and list of permitted spokespeople. Also confirm whether OEM requires an NDA for embargo materials. Can't promise public release without signed terms.
Faye (Marketing): If OEM requires NDA, that slows translation/localization. Suggest: redwood preps APAC copy with placeholders and mark as embargo-NDA.
Carlos (Platform): Also flag: MI300 runtime shows a 3-5% throughput regression with the latest quantized kernels on Gaudi fallback path. Vendor offered a runtime patch but it's not signed yet. That affects our perf slides.
Nora (Solutions): SI says they'd like a dry-run of the marketplace flow (order -> provision -> onboarding) before announce. Can we schedule a joint lab window next week?
Priya (Partnerships): Proposed cadence: 1) internal embargo pack by Thu (Redwood+SI+Vendor), 2) vendor signs embargo by Fri, 3) joint dry-run next Tue, 4) public announce Wed + region availability notes. Does that align?
Jasper (Legal): Friday signature is tight but OK if vendor sends draft NDA now. Ping me DM.
Faye (Marketing): I'll draft a neutral headline that doesn't call out exact SKUs (use family names) so we don't have to re-run localization if SKUs adjust. Also prepping visuals for general perf ranges not exact numbers.
Carlos (Platform): Ops note: if firmware microcode is delayed, we should include "/availability: rolling" in the marketplace listing to avoid hard dates. Also mark nodes with "derate" label to prevent SLA promises.
release-bot: meeting created partnerships/embargo-handoff 2026-04-01T16:00:00Z.
Priya (Partnerships): Action items: Vendor - send NDA + signed runtime patch; SI - confirm dry-run team + test accounts; Platform - build derate label and perf slide placeholder; Marketing - embargo pack draft by Thu. I'll follow up with vendor PM.
Nora (Solutions): Confirmed SI participants: Mark, Aisha, and Jin. They can run dry-run Tue 09:00 PT.
Faye (Marketing): I put the draft pack in /marketing/embargo/embargo_pack_v1.md and locked it. Link: https://redwood.example/embargo/embargo_pack_v1.md (internal).
Carlos (Platform): I'll create the derate labels in the marketplace metadata and patch the perf slide placeholders.
Jasper (Legal): Received vendor NDA draft via DM. Reviewing; will respond within 24h.
Priya (Partnerships): Thanks all. If vendor doesn't provide signed runtime patch by EOD Mon, we decouple Gaudi perf claims from the announce. Keep this thread updated.
